apps.localizedDescription:
YouTube with Shorts permanently removed.

The NoShortsEver tweak unconditionally strips:
• The Shorts button in the navigation bar
• Shorts shelves and cells in feeds, search results, and channels
• Any Short that still opens is reopened in the normal video player

Paired with YTLite 5.2b3 (ad-blocking, background playback) on YouTube 20.32.4 - a combination reported to have working playback on sideloaded installs.
apps.versionDescription: Pairs stock YTLite 5.2b3 with YouTube 20.32.4 - the exact combination a user reported playing fine in YTLite issue #364, where 5.2b4 broke playback on the same base. All previous builds used YTLite 5.2.2, much newer than any version reported working. Shorts removal via NoShortsEver. Requires DELETE + REINSTALL (version goes down).

Reports the genuine YouTube version (21.28.3) to InnerTube. Earlier 21.28.3.x builds advertised a four-component version that is not a real YouTube release, which is the documented trigger for the 'Something went wrong' playback cutoff. Requires DELETE + REINSTALL (the version number goes down). Same Shorts removal.

Reverted the YTUHD playback-fix experiment: it crashed on launch on the 21.28.3 base. Back to the known-good YTLite + NoShortsEver build (same as 21.28.3.4). Shorts removed, sign-in URL fix, relaunch scheme. Signed-out playback on 21.x still cuts off after ~1 min; sign-in is the next thing to try.

21.28.3 base with an added decoder-level playback fix (YTUHD 'Fix playback issues'). After installing, open Settings > YTUHD and turn ON 'Fix playback issues', then force-quit and reopen YouTube. Testing whether this clears the 21.x 'Something went wrong' cutoff without needing an older base. Same Shorts removal, sign-in URL fix, and relaunch-scheme fix.

Rebuilt on YouTube 19.33.2 to fix the 'Something went wrong' playback cutoff (newer YouTube enforces a server-side integrity check that breaks sideloaded playback). Same Shorts removal, sign-in fix, and relaunch-scheme fix. Sign-in may work again on this older base.
